title: Joseph Interprets Dreams in Prison

questions.question: Whose dreams did Joseph interpret in prison?
questions.explanation: Genesis 40:5: "The cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt...each his own dream."

questions.question: What happened to the cupbearer?
options: He was restored to his position
questions.correctAnswer: He was restored to his position
questions.explanation: Genesis 40:21: "He restored the chief cupbearer to his position."

questions.question: What happened to the baker?
questions.explanation: Genesis 40:22: "But he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them."

questions.question: Who did Joseph say could interpret dreams?
questions.explanation: Genesis 40:8: "Joseph said to them, 'Do not interpretations belong to God?'"

questions.question: Did the cupbearer remember Joseph after being freed?
questions.explanation: Genesis 40:23: "Yet the chief cupbearer did not remember Joseph, but forgot him."

questions.question: What was in the cupbearer's dream?
options: A vine with three branches bearing grapes
questions.correctAnswer: A vine with three branches bearing grapes
questions.explanation: Genesis 40:9-10: "In my dream there was a vine before me, and on the vine there were three branches."

questions.question: What was in the baker's dream?
options: Three baskets of bread on his head
questions.correctAnswer: Three baskets of bread on his head
questions.explanation: Genesis 40:16: "I also had a dream: there were three cake baskets on my head."

questions.question: What did the three branches/baskets represent?
questions.explanation: Genesis 40:12-13, 18: "The three branches are three days...the three baskets are three days."

questions.question: What did Joseph ask the cupbearer to do?
options: Remember him and mention him to Pharaoh
questions.correctAnswer: Remember him and mention him to Pharaoh
questions.explanation: Genesis 40:14: "Only remember me, when it is well with you, and please do me the kindness to mention me to Pharaoh."

questions.question: Why were the cupbearer and baker in prison?
questions.explanation: Genesis 40:1: "The cupbearer of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord the king of Egypt."

questions.question: What detail in the baker's dream foreshadowed his fate?
options: Birds ate from the top basket
questions.correctAnswer: Birds ate from the top basket
questions.explanation: Genesis 40:17: "The birds were eating it out of the basket on my head."

questions.question: What did Joseph say about how he ended up in prison?
options: He was stolen from the land of the Hebrews and done nothing wrong
questions.correctAnswer: He was stolen from the land of the Hebrews and done nothing wrong
questions.explanation: Genesis 40:15: "For I was indeed stolen out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the pit."

questions.question: How did Joseph notice the officials were troubled?
questions.explanation: Genesis 40:6-7: "He saw that they were troubled. So he asked...Why are your faces downcast today?"

questions.question: What did the cupbearer do in Pharaoh's cup in his dream?
options: Pressed grapes into the cup and placed it in Pharaoh's hand
questions.correctAnswer: Pressed grapes into the cup and placed it in Pharaoh's hand
questions.explanation: Genesis 40:11: "I took the grapes and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup and placed the cup in Pharaoh's hand."

questions.question: On what occasion was the baker hanged and cupbearer restored?
questions.explanation: Genesis 40:20: "On the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday, he made a feast."

key_verse_text: Do not interpretations belong to God? Please tell them to me.
